specs.title: [F2P][D11] Every number in the margin stands beside the line of the crib it counts.
[F2P][D11] The margin numbering has not drifted away from the crib by the foot of a long dance.
[F2P][D11] The margin and the writing beside it are set to the same rhythm.
[F2P][D11] Each place heading in the set stands over the couple standing in that place.
[P2P] The desk publishes the figure book with a length against every figure.
[P2P] The crib library offers every dance the desk is holding, the devised one included.
[P2P] Choosing a dance from the library puts its writing into the editor.
[P2P] The stave sets out one numbered row for every line the devisor wrote.
[P2P] The stave reprints the crib exactly as it was written, indents and all.
[P2P] A figure the book does not contain is named back to the devisor against its own bar.
[P2P] An empty crib is not passed as a dance.
[P2P] The set diagram opens with a rank for the top of the dance and adds one for every phrase.
[P2P] The set diagram shows the couples in the places each phrase leaves them.
[P2P] Every phrase is listed with the span it was written under and the bars it asks for.
[P2P] The desk reaches its checking service from the address the page was served from.
